does: Tells whether a character will be able to pay a list of action-resource costs on its next turn, cost by cost.

evidence.says: walks the eoc::action_resource::ActionResourceCost array (0x30 bytes each) through CanUseResourceCost and, for a cost that fails now, checks the resource's replenish type
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (segments 36, 39, 44), 14 times from 1 place in the combat AI request code at +0x3108200
